acyclicRule.description: An acyclic Rule: forbids dependency cycles among declared Modules.

acyclic.description: Cycle scope: a list of declared Modules, or an empty mapping for every declared Module.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

caseSpec.description: File-name case vocabulary: one or more alternatives of kebab-case, snake_case, camelCase, PascalCase, or regex:PATTERN, combined with | (any-of); applies to the file stem, extension excluded.

consumesRule.description: An imports Rule: states what a Module may import: declared Modules by allow-list, external and standard-library imports by policy.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

imports.description: What the Module may import. At least one restriction must be declared: an internal allow-list, external: forbid, or stdlib: forbid.

internal.description: Declared Modules this Module may import; absent means unrestricted, empty means none. The owning Module is always permitted implicitly.

on.description: The declared Module or Modules the Rule judges.

contentRule.description: A content Rule: forbids lines matching a regular expression in the selected files.

content.description: Content no selected file may contain.

forbid.description: RE2 regular expression; every matching line is one Violation.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

files.description: Narrows the files judged; absent means every selected file.

on.description: The declared Module or Modules the Rule judges; absent means the whole repository.

exclusion.description: Removes paths or Modules from what the Rule judges; excluded subjects evaluate not applicable.

modules.description: Modules the Rule no longer judges.

paths.description: Files the Rule no longer judges.

expandedGlob.description: Structure glob that may carry {name:<case>} placeholders, each resolving once per recorded term; cases are PascalCase, camelCase, flatcase, kebab-case, snake_case.

expansionSource.description: Recorded Ubiquitous Language collection an expanded structure Rule derives its globs from.

extensionRule.description: A uses Rule: delegates enforcement to a named Extension through the sandboxed SDK.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

files.description: Narrows the files judged; absent means every selected file.

on.description: The declared Module or Modules the Rule judges; absent means the whole repository.

uses.description: The extension rule name registered under .arclint/extensions or distributed by an extended Pattern.

with.description: Parameters validated host-side against the extension's published schema before any extension code runs.

glob.description: Repo-relative path pattern: * and ? never cross /, a ** segment matches any number of segments, [...] matches one character. Brace alternation is rejected.

globs.description: One glob or a non-empty list of globs.

independenceRule.description: An independent Rule: forbids imports between sibling Folders selected by globs.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

independent.description: Globs selecting sibling Folders that may not import each other; at least one, no duplicates.

invariantsRule.description: An invariants Rule: requires recorded domain contracts to be visible in source as named methods called from their join points.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

invariants.description: Evaluation posture. closed: false (default): child constructors may return errors. closed: true: every exported error-returning function in the owner's files must call the cluster method.

closed.description: When true, extra exported error-returning functions that do not call the cluster method fail. Default: false.

on.description: The declared Module or Modules the Rule judges.

layersRule.description: A layers Rule: orders Modules highest first; a Module may import same or lower layers, never higher.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

layers.description: Modules ordered highest first; at least two, no duplicates.

module.description: One Module: a glob, a list of globs, or an object in a repository ruleset; a description or an object in a Pattern file.

paths.description: Membership selectors; a glob naming a directory claims its whole subtree.

moduleNames.description: One Module name or a non-empty list of Module names.

namingRule.description: A naming Rule: constrains file names within a Module to a finite case vocabulary.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

files.description: Narrows the files judged; absent means every selected file.

naming.description: The case vocabulary file stems must match: the case spec itself, or an object with case.

on.description: The declared Module or Modules the Rule judges.

override.description: An Override of a Rule an extended Pattern distributes, keyed by that Rule's qualified ID. It carries no assertion and no description: it disables the Rule with a reason, changes its severity, excludes subjects, or suppresses findings. To change what a Pattern Rule asserts, disable it and add a local Rule under a new ID.

patternModule.description: One Pattern Module: its description, or an object with the description and the paths the Pattern suggests for the Binding. A Pattern never owns paths.

paths.description: Paths the Pattern suggests; arclint init --pattern writes them into bind.

patternReference.description: Exact reference to one published Pattern version: namespace/name@version.

protectedRule.description: An imported_by Rule: restricts which Modules may import one Module.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

imported_by.description: Modules permitted to import the Module named under on; empty means none.

on.description: The one declared Module the Rule protects.

reason.description: The recorded reason for an adoption decision; required so the decision stays inspectable.

repositoryModule.description: One repository Module: its paths as a glob or a list of globs, or an object with paths and an optional description.

paths.description: Membership selectors; a glob naming a directory claims its whole subtree.

rule.description: One Rule carrying exactly one assertion key (imports, structure, naming, layers, imported_by, independent, acyclic, invariants, content, uses), or an Override carrying none.

ruleID.description: Explicit stable Rule ID: LOCAL for a repository Rule, or NAMESPACE/NAME:LOCAL for a Rule an extended Pattern distributes. LOCAL uses a-z 0-9 . _ - /, never starting with . / - and never ending with . or /. Inside a Pattern file the Rule ID is local; the loader qualifies it with the Pattern's namespace/name, so two Patterns may distribute the same local identity.

structureRule.description: A structure Rule: requires or forbids files matching globs inside a Module.

description.description: The Claim: the architectural proposition the Rule states. Derived canonically when absent; Pattern Rules should write one.

on.description: The declared Module or Modules the Rule judges.

structure.description: Files the Module must or must not contain. With each, the globs derive from a recorded vocabulary collection and may carry {name:<case>} placeholders.

oneOf.description: Plain structure: at least one non-empty glob list.

forbid.description: No member file may match any glob.

require.description: Each glob must match at least one member file.

oneOf.description: Expanded structure: one universally quantified claim whose globs derive from a recorded Ubiquitous Language collection. A project recording nothing derives no obligations; the Rule exists and says so.

forbid.description: No member file may match any glob.

require.description: Each glob must match at least one member file.

suppression.description: Keeps findings at the paths while removing their gate effect; suppressed findings are still reported.

description: The complete rules.yaml document ArcLint accepts. A repository ruleset carries runtime, scan, extends, modules, and rules; a Pattern distribution file carries the pattern header, modules, and rules. Every Rule is keyed by its Rule ID and carries exactly one assertion key; an entry with no assertion key is an Override of a Rule an extended Pattern distributes. Unknown keys are rejected everywhere.

else.description: A repository ruleset: every Module carries paths, directly or through a Binding.

extends.description: Patterns this repository adopts. Each entry pins one exact version and binds every Module the Pattern lists to repository paths. Repository rulesets only.

items.description: One adopted Pattern and its Bindings.

bind.description: Paths for every Module the Pattern lists, keyed by Module name: one glob or a list of globs. The only place a Pattern Module's paths live.

modules.description: Declared Modules keyed by name. In a repository ruleset a Module is a glob, a list of globs, or an object with paths and description. In a Pattern file a Module is its description, or an object with description and the paths it suggests for the Binding.

pattern.description: Pattern identity header, present only in a Pattern distribution file, never in a repository ruleset.

coverage.description: Runtime targets the Pattern's Rules were written for, spelled exactly like the repository runtime list.

documentation.description: Where readers learn what the Pattern enforces and why: a URL or a short text.

namespace.description: Pattern namespace; with the name it qualifies every distributed Rule ID as namespace/name:local.

version.description: Exact published version; never part of Rule identity.

rules.description: Every Rule keyed by its Rule ID. An entry with one assertion key is a Rule; an entry with none is an Override of a Rule an extended Pattern distributes, keyed by that Rule's qualified ID.

runtime.description: Language targets whose code facts observation produces. Repository rulesets only.

scan.description: Repository observation policy: what the walk excludes and how unknown imports are treated.

exclude.description: Globs the repository walk skips entirely.

unknown_imports.description: Policy for imports that classify neither stdlib, internal, nor external.

then.description: A Pattern distribution file: no runtime, no scan, no extends, because those are repository policy; Modules carry descriptions and suggested paths only.

rules.description: A Pattern distributes Rules and cannot override: every entry carries exactly one assertion key.
